connector.name: AILANG Parse
connector.registryDescription: Deterministic DOCX/PPTX/XLSX/PDF parser: track changes, comments, headers, footers, merged cells.
connector.summary: Hosted at docparse.ailang.sunholo.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package parse. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sunholo-data account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DOCPARSE_API_KEY
env.description: AILANG Parse API key (dp_...). Optional — the bridge auto-loads keys saved at ~/.config/ailang-parse/credentials.json. Get one from https://www.sunholo.com/ailang-parse/

env.name: AILANG_PARSE_MCP_URL
env.description: Override the hosted MCP endpoint. Defaults to https://docparse.ailang.sunholo.com/mcp/
